description:
The image depicts a serene beach scene, with a white surfboard featuring blue flower designs standing upright in the sand. To the right of the surfboard, a statue of a woman in a blue swimsuit and head covering stands with her left hand on her hip. She faces away from the camera, gazing out at the ocean.
